_README: Sampling config for a citation-labelled eval set on jp_egov (sample_corpus.py). Markers are Japanese: no word boundaries, plain phrases (Postgres ~*). Strata follow the corpus: 2,103 Acts, 2,314 Cabinet Orders, 4,101 Ministerial Ordinances, 476 others.

numeric.marker: [0-9０-９一二三四五六七八九十百千]+(日|月|年|時間)以内|円以下|円以上|百分の|パーセント

procedural.marker: (届け出|申請|提出|通知|報告)(し|を)

exception.marker: この限りでない|を除く|にかかわらず

sanction.marker: 罰金|懲役|拘禁刑|過料|科料

authority.marker: 政令で定める|省令で定める|命令で定める|内閣府令で定める

multi_tier.marker: 法律第[一二三四五六七八九十百千]+号|法（[^）]+）第
